headline: Frontend Architect · Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Architect with {years}+ years of experience delivering enterprise web platforms for clients in India and Singapore. Specialises in React, Next.js (App Router) and Vue 3 component systems on headless Drupal, with a focus on performance, accessibility and maintainable architecture. Also designs, builds and operates three multi-tenant SaaS products end to end, covering data model, authentication, testing, deployment and production incidents, using AI coding assistants inside a reviewed engineering workflow.

Webspiders: Implemented SEO foundations: semantic HTML, structured metadata, Open Graph and server-side rendering.
Worked with UX designers, backend engineers and product managers through UAT and production releases.

halkhata: Server-authoritative money in integer paise, idempotent orders under a unique key, and race-safe stock decrements inside the sale transaction.
Stateless HMAC-signed sessions verified at the Edge and re-verified against the database before any write; credential versioning revokes every device on a PIN reset.
Wrote up a production data-loss incident and added a database-target guard that refuses production unless explicitly overridden.
eduflow: Four-role multi-tenant SaaS with tenant isolation enforced on every read and write and data scoped by role on the server.
Diagnosed and fixed a failing billing cron (Postgres 42P10 on a partial-index ON CONFLICT) that had stopped monthly fee generation for live centres.
Integration tests run on in-memory Postgres (PGlite) built from the real SQL migrations and gate every deploy.
healthlocker: Server-first Next.js monolith on 49 Prisma models; tenant derived from the session, AES-GCM column encryption and a nonce-based CSP.
Found and closed two cross-tenant authorization holes and proved the fix with a role-by-guard test matrix.
CI on every push: lint, typecheck, 250 unit tests, about 100 integration blocks, a production build and a smoke render of every page per role.
